text: Appeal of Order to Comply (May 13, 2019) for 44 Burton Road.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply, dated May 13, 2019, regarding the property located at 44 Burton Road, Folder No. 19 153243 PRS 00 IV, and doing so granted an extension of time to September 20, 2019.
